node.title: Re: How can I convert this raw data to a hash?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
That looks very much like [wp://JSON], so you'd need to use a JSON module like [mod://Cpanel::JSON::XS], or [doc://JSON::PP] has been in the core since Perl 5.14.

If you need help in further processing this data and looping over it, then please explain what you'd like to do (with code) and what your expected output is. See also [doc://perldsc], [doc://perlreftut], and [doc://perlref].
